payload.title: The feeding engine's tenant discovery, its feeding_job_runs claim and its zone read run outside any tenant context against FORCE-RLS tables, so the hourly tick finds no tenant, records no run and generates no day plan on production
evidence: apps/farm-service/src/feeding-protocol/services/feeding-cron-v2.service.ts:1461 (feedingTenants and tenantsForRetention: bare QueryRunner + SET search_path, at 8ba4123d8)
apps/farm-service/src/feeding-protocol/services/feeding-job-run.service.ts:53 (INSERT INTO farm.feeding_job_runs via dataSource.query, no tenant context)
payload.rule_violated: A cross-tenant worker reads and writes a FORCE-RLS table only inside a tenant context (runInTenantTransaction), listing tenants from the platform ledger
payload.notes: Fixed by findTenantsMatching (backend-common) + per-tenant claim/settle/purge + per-tenant zone read; proven by feeding-cron-v2.discovery.rls.postgres.spec.ts (non-owner role, FORCE RLS).
narrative: Production 2026-10-26, read-only, as SET LOCAL ROLE farm_service: the discovery probe sees 0 rows where the owner sees 2 live assignments; farm.feeding_job_runs holds 0 rows for every tenant, ever; the test tenant has one day plan (2026-10-11); the legacy scheduler logs 'K-5 cutover: legacy plan generation gated off' nightly.
